title: An attacker can massively inflate the share value
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Since the total assets/shares are tracked via an internal storage variable, a traditional vault inflation attack cannot occur in the Fraxlend pairs. However, by exploiting the rounding directions when minting/burning shares, an attacker can exponentially inflate the value of a single share, allowing them to steal 100% of the first deposit from the first depositor, and DoS that lending pair from proper usage in the future.
